name: NuBlox Developer Handoff Pack

product.governing_security_rule: Career != Organisation Role != Project Role != Permission

authentication_and_tenancy.tenant_authority: active NuBlox user + active organisation_members row
authentication_and_tenancy.selected_organisation_cookie: selection hint only; server revalidates membership
authentication_and_tenancy.signup_policy: fail-closed; exactly one valid invitation or organisation-bootstrap intent
authentication_and_tenancy.foreign_record_policy: tenant-owned foreign public IDs are masked where disclosure would leak tenant identity

permission_model.umbrella_policy: resolve granular key first; same-domain umbrella applies only when granular has no explicit member/role decision; explicit granular deny cannot be bypassed
permission_model.cross_domain_policy: permission umbrellas never cross domain families

Owner.package_004_policy: explicit contract formation/execution/amendment plus finance invoice/credit-note/void/payment granular grants and finance.manage

Administrator.package_004_policy: explicit contract formation/execution/amendment plus finance invoice/credit-note/void/payment granular grants and finance.manage

standard_roles.bootstrap_parity: existing-tenant forward migration grants and future OrganisationBootstrapService grants are asserted at persisted role-permission-row level, including Package 004E payment grants and stronger invoice-void exclusion from Finance/Commercial

implemented_workflow: Controlled Invoice Issue and Immutable Evidence
Controlled Credit-Note Issue and Immutable Evidence
Payment Reversal with Active Allocation Reversal

non_effects: no contract formation inside conversion transaction

contract_formation.initial_value: fixed-precision sum of non-optional accepted quotation net lines
contract_formation.execution_policy: issued+locked version -> execution/signatory evidence -> version executed + logical contract active; project lifecycle remains independent

contract_amendments.eligibility: same-tenant active logical contract with executed contract-version baseline
contract_amendments.value_policy: signed DECIMAL(19,4); positive increases, negative decreases, zero rejected; no JavaScript binary floating point for authoritative arithmetic
contract_amendments.current_value_formula: executed baseline value components + sum(agreed amendment value adjustments)

accounts_receivable_invoices.creation_policy: finance.invoice.create OR finance.manage AND contract.view; source contract must be same-tenant active with executed baseline and client party
accounts_receivable_invoices.numbering_policy: tenant-local INV-000001 etc.; number allocated only inside issue transaction
accounts_receivable_invoices.tax_policy: draft tax is provisional; effective tenant rate is resolved again at actual invoice issue time
accounts_receivable_invoices.snapshot_policy: issue snapshots customer, optional billing contact and billing-address evidence
accounts_receivable_invoices.immutability_policy: issued invoice rejects ordinary draft header/line mutation

receivable_corrections.source_policy: credit-note source must be a same-tenant issued numbered invoice with positive remaining creditable value
receivable_corrections.provenance_policy: each credit-note item maps to exactly one original invoice item through credit_note_item_sources
receivable_corrections.magnitude_policy: credit quantities and amounts are positive; document_kind=credit_note supplies the receivable sign
receivable_corrections.tax_policy: credit tax uses the original invoice item's persisted applied_rate_percent, not the tax rate current on the credit-note date
receivable_corrections.overcredit_policy: credit-note issue locks the original invoice and rejects cumulative issued+current quantities above the source invoice quantity
receivable_corrections.snapshot_policy: issued credit note copies the original invoice party/address snapshots rather than current CRM facts
receivable_corrections.numbering_policy: tenant-local CN-000001 etc.; number allocated only at issue
receivable_corrections.immutability_policy: issued credit note rejects ordinary draft reason/line mutation
receivable_corrections.invoice_void_policy: finance.invoice.void OR finance.manage; issued invoice + explicit reason; blocked by non-void credit-note history or unreversed payment allocation; preserves legal evidence

payment_receipt_allocation.receipt_policy: finance.payment.create OR finance.manage; immutable positive receipt fact with method/date/currency/reference and optional same-tenant CRM payer; recording cash does not imply allocation
payment_receipt_allocation.payer_policy: selecting a payer requires crm.view; payer may differ from invoice customer and is surfaced for review rather than hard-blocked
payment_receipt_allocation.invoice_outstanding_formula: issued invoice gross - issued credit-note gross - active payment allocations
payment_receipt_allocation.allocation_policy: finance.payment.allocate OR finance.manage; same tenant; non-reversed payment; issued invoice; exact currency match; positive amount; no payment or invoice over-allocation
payment_receipt_allocation.locking_policy: allocation locks payment then target invoice and recomputes both authoritative balances before insert
payment_receipt_allocation.allocation_reversal_policy: immutable payment_allocation_reversals row with actor/timestamp/reason; original allocation remains visible
payment_receipt_allocation.payment_reversal_policy: payment reversal transaction first reverses every still-active allocation, then inserts immutable payment_reversals evidence; reversed payment cannot be reallocated
payment_receipt_allocation.settlement_policy: invoice legal lifecycle is separate from derived open/part_settled/settled receivable position
non_effects: no FX conversion or cross-currency allocation
no refunds or outbound customer payments
no customer statements or aged receivables

validation.status: executable Package 004E head validated; final documentation-synchronised PR head must prove the same gate before merge

next_boundary.name: Customer Statements and Aged Receivables
recommended_sequence: derived customer account positions from issued invoices, issued credits and active allocations
statement period and opening/closing position presentation
aging buckets from invoice due dates and outstanding receivable
separate dunning/reminder policy and communication evidence
next_boundary.governing_rule: statements and aging derive from immutable issued documents, issued credits, active allocations and due dates rather than editable stored balances
